controller_12m.notes: Independently re-verified. Quote on p260 matches verbatim: Rule 10.07(1)(b) 'in the period of six months commencing on the date on which the First Six-Month Period expires (the "Second Six-Month Period") ... if, immediately following such disposal ... it/he/she would cease to be a Controlling Shareholder'. FSP expires 2027-03-29 (restricted day), so SSP commences 2027-03-29; six-month window [2027-03-29, 2027-09-28] inclusive, first free = 2027-09-29 — matches candidate and is internally consistent (first free equals the 12-month anniversary of the Listing Date). Correctly characterized as a conditional loss-of-control restriction, not a blanket 12-month ban; non-control-losing disposals are possible from 2027-03-30. Holders same Controlling Shareholders Group as 6m block (verified p26/p117). Note 3 to Rule 10.07(2) obligations during both periods confirmed on p260. No corrections.
